race.comment: Interesting race. There's a fair bit of intertwining form but working it out isn't easy. What we do know is that BRILLANTEZZA (3) proved the superior stayer over 2500m at Flemington off a fast speed and came away to win it well. Where she gets to from barrier 11 is the knock. KINGS REFLECTION (7) was well backed behind that filly at Flemington and ran well for second. She'll need a touch of luck from an inside gate as well. DECALOGUE (1) was a narrow early favourite in that Flemington race but they scratched and came here over 2000m instead. They walked in front and he got very keen in behind in a forgivable run. Now to 2400m which is also an unknown. DIRNASEER (2) closed off well here latest and 2400m looks okay for him, including. The big improver might be FERRARIO (10) who worked home well there off the slow pace and looks to be crying out for more ground - plus he's got more upside than any of them.
